verdict.rationale: FFmpeg publishes per-release API reference documentation (Doxygen for 9.0, 8.1, 8.0 alongside nightly trunk), which shows its library APIs are versioned. Release notes show at least one old API being replaced by the AVChannelLayout API, which implies deprecation does happen. However, the pack contains no documented deprecation policy, timelines, or compatibility guarantees, and one community report says libav API docs and tutorials are often outdated. Missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation policy, documented API versioning/compatibility guarantees, migration guides, independent corroboration.
